dchem.reaction.sodium_chloride_crystalli: 1 mol Na+ and 1 mol Cl- crystallize into salt (northstar:salt) in heated brine, catalyzed by cobblestone. Barely reacts without heat.
dchem.reaction.sodium_chloride_dissoluti: Salt dissolves in water back into sodium and chloride ions (brine).
dchem.reaction.meat_dissolution.descript: Raw pork or beef dissolves into meat slurry in any liquid. No distilled water needed - any liquid in a basin or vat works, and no heating is required.
dchem.reaction.meat_slurry_hydrolysis.de: Meat slurry hydrolyzes into glycerol and rotten flesh, catalyzed by hydroxide (OH-). Works at room temperature with no heating - but without hydroxide (an alkaline solution such as limewater or sodium hydroxide solution) it will not happen.
dchem.reaction.carbonate_protonation.des: Carbonate picks up a proton to form bicarbonate.
dchem.reaction.hydroxide_carbonation.des: 2 mol hydroxide and 1 mol carbon dioxide react to form carbonate and water (alkaline solutions absorbing CO2, consuming the hydroxide).
dchem.reaction.carbonate_absorption.desc: Once the hydroxide is used up, carbonate keeps absorbing carbon dioxide and water to form 2 mol bicarbonate (why carbonate solutions turn clear when gassed).
Strong acid fully protonates carbonate, releasing carbon dioxide gas.
dchem.reaction.bicarbonate_protonation.d: Bicarbonate reacts with a proton to release carbon dioxide and water.
dchem.reaction.carbonic_acid_formation.d: Carbon dioxide dissolves in water to slowly form carbonic acid.
dchem.reaction.carbonic_acid_decompositi: Carbonic acid is unstable and decomposes into carbon dioxide and water.
dchem.reaction.carbonic_acid_dissociatio: Carbonic acid partially dissociates into a proton and bicarbonate.
dchem.reaction.bicarbonate_association.d: Bicarbonate picks up a proton to reform carbonic acid.
Bicarbonate partially dissociates into a proton and carbonate.
dchem.reaction.carbonate_hydrolysis.desc: Carbonate reacts with water to form bicarbonate and hydroxide, making carbonate solutions basic.
dchem.reaction.bicarbonate_neutralizatio: Bicarbonate neutralizes hydroxide into carbonate and water.
dchem.reaction.calcium_carbonate_precipi: Calcium and carbonate ions precipitate insoluble calcium carbonate - chalk dust (Destroy's calcium carbonate).
dchem.reaction.calcium_carbonate_calcina: At extreme heat, calcium carbonate decomposes into quicklime (calcium oxide) and carbon dioxide - the reverse of the lime cycle.
dchem.reaction.carbonate_thermal_decompo: At extreme heat, carbonate decomposes into carbon dioxide and oxide ions.
